description: State-machine and collision cases used to review a visual plan. Each case states the input condition, the required outcome, and the condition that makes it fail.
coordinate_system: normalized top-left origin, x right, y down

cases.given: one image_insert while the speaker is in frame
cases.fail_if: anchor.y outside 0.56-0.68 without safe_area_decision, or head_box overlap

cases.given: a second asset starts while the first is still primary
cases.fail_if: old asset keeps primary scale or contrast in the new asset's first frame

cases.given: a third asset starts while two assets are already visible
cases.fail_if: three assets share equal width, contrast, or motion intensity

cases.given: a fourth asset starts and the frame cannot hold four legible items
cases.fail_if: all four shrink below readable size, or the oldest keeps a secondary slot without a reason

cases.given: the default primary anchor overlaps head_box
cases.fail_if: asset partially overlaps the head, or the plan keeps 0.618 without a reason

cases.given: start and end frames are clear but the entrance path sweeps across the head
cases.fail_if: only the first and last frames were checked

cases.given: the primary would overlap the 0.75-0.82 caption band
cases.fail_if: asset overlaps captions, or captions were moved into the bottom 12% safe area

cases.given: a generated clip covers the full frame while the speaker keeps talking
cases.fail_if: speaker disappears, inset uses a still frame, inset jumps corners mid-segment, or covers the asset's title/labels

cases.given: all four inset corners would cover the asset's key subject or text
cases.fail_if: full-frame presentation kept with the avatar covering content, or speaker dropped entirely
